title: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
summary: SolidCraft is an open-source parametric CAD (Computer-Aided Design) application built entirely in Rust, featuring Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration for AI-assisted design workflows. It aims to provide a free, performant, and memory-safe alternative to proprietary CAD software while enabling AI-driven automation and context-aware interactions.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source, memory-safe parametric CAD solution with AI integration capabilities, challenging expensive proprietary CAD tools.
why_valuable: Combines Rust's performance and safety guarantees with modern AI integration, making professional CAD design accessible while enabling intelligent automation through MCP.
